projects.title: Real Projects
projects.description: Real cases showing the client's pain point, how we solved it, and the technologies used

scheduling.title: Apex Barber
scheduling.pain: The barbershop struggled with manual scheduling: clients waiting in line with no way to book in advance, frequent no-shows, inability to choose a preferred barber, and wasted time managing walk-in queues.
scheduling.solution: We built a complete barbershop website with online booking, a full-service catalog with pricing, barber selection, a gallery showcasing the craft, and client reviews — all optimized for mobile and deployed on Vercel.

trmil.title: TRMIL
trmil.pain: Company needed a professional digital presence to attract new clients and showcase their services in a modern, trustworthy way.
trmil.solution: We built a platform with a React frontend and a Strapi (Headless CMS) backend on Node.js with TypeScript, including support for three languages: Portuguese, English, and Spanish.

prontu.title: Prontu Tupuca
prontu.pain: Need to connect sellers and buyers on an efficient digital platform with order and payment management.
prontu.solution: We developed a mobile and backend solution with Flutter for the app, Strapi as the Headless CMS, PostgreSQL as the database, and FastAPI as the main API orchestration layer.

meihub.title: MeiHub
meihub.pain: Individual micro-entrepreneurs (MEI) had difficulty managing their tax obligations, finances, and documents in one place.
meihub.solution: We created a complete mobile app for MEI management with financial control, obligation reminders, and document issuance.

topdevjobs.title: Top Dev Jobs
topdevjobs.pain: Developers struggled to find relevant job openings and companies had difficulty reaching qualified tech talent.
topdevjobs.solution: We developed a jobs platform with React and Node.js, including Google login, Web API validations, n8n automations, and a Strapi (Headless CMS) backend.

mrjay.title: Mr. Jay
mrjay.pain: Millions of Brazilians want to speak English but face expensive courses (R$200–500/month), fear of making mistakes, rigid class schedules, and apps that only teach vocabulary without any real conversation practice.
mrjay.solution: We built an AI-powered English teacher using React, TypeScript, OpenAI, and Node.js. Payments are handled via QR code and access is manually approved in Telegram after confirmation. The system currently works with 2 locales.
